Interface DigitalLoas

All Known Implementing Classes:
DigitalLoasImpl
public interface DigitalLoas
Client interface for managing Digital Letters of Authorization (Digital LOAs) in the Equinix Customer Portal.

Backed by the diLOA v1 API at /diloa/v1/digitalLoas. A Digital LOA is created with create(DigitalLoaCreateRequest), retrieved with findByUuid(String) or search(DigitalLoaSearchRequest), modified with update(String, List), actioned with performAction(String, Map) and invalidated with cancel(String). The audit trail of changes is available via findChangesByLoaUuid(String) and findChangeByUuid(String, String).

    • listOrganizations

      List<? extends LoaCustomerOrganization> listOrganizations(String ibx)
      Lists the customer organizations available in the given IBX data center that the current user may use as a Digital LOA requestor.

      Private beta endpoint (GET /diloa/v1/organizations). The location.ibx query parameter is required by the API.

      Parameters:
      ibx - the IBX data center identifier (e.g. AM11); required
      Returns:
      the customer organizations

    • listOrganizations

      List<? extends LoaCustomerOrganization> listOrganizations(String ibx, List<String> productTypes)
      Lists the customer organizations available in the given IBX data center, filtered by product type, that the current user may use as a Digital LOA requestor.

      Private beta endpoint (GET /diloa/v1/organizations). The location.ibx query parameter is required by the API; product.type is optional.

      Parameters:
      ibx - the IBX data center identifier (e.g. AM11); required
      productTypes - the product types to filter by (e.g. CROSS_CONNECT), or null
      Returns:
      the customer organizations
